title: Shearing Time
offer: The sheep are shorn! Nine sacks of fleece for Sæunn the weaver. Nine are more than your boat takes: two trips, or a clever packing.

fleece.name: Fleece
fleece.counted: {count|a sack of fleece|{count} sacks of fleece}

steps.load_say: Soft and greasy. Your hands will be soft too!
steps.say: Nine sacks! My looms will clatter all summer. Here is a bolt of cloth for you.

fact: Sheep were shorn with iron shears, or their wool was plucked when it came loose.
